en: An illustrated vintage postcard framed with decorative Art Nouveau borders, showing a long Renaissance-style building with many windows and a clock tower rising above a red-tiled roof. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street in front. At the bottom is printed text in German identifying the scene, and a purple archival stamp with a handwritten year appears in the lower right corner.
